run_annotation_tool: run the BOP manual annotation tool GUI to annotate 6D poses for a dataset scene
create_point_cloud_from_rgbd: create a 3D point cloud from RGB and depth images using camera intrinsic parameters
refine_object_pose_with_icp: refine an annotated object pose using ICP point-to-plane registration against the scene point cloud
generate_scene_gt_json: generate or update the scene_gt.json file with 6D pose annotations for all annotated objects
load_and_display_scene: load a BOP dataset scene with RGB, depth, and camera params then display it in the 3D viewer
